name: Cape Town
about: Mediterranean climate flipped south: warm dry summer Nov–Mar for beaches/hiking, wet winter Jun–Aug (good whale season).
overview: Table Mountain, wine country, and penguin-dotted beaches packed into one city, with Africa's most diverse food and lodging scene close behind.
costOverview: Inexpensive even at the nicer end — a proper restaurant meal or a serious wine tasting still costs a fraction of what it would elsewhere.

costItems.label: Curry in a bread bowl (bunny chow)

specialSeasons.text: Southern right whales come close to shore this time of year, often visible from land around Hermanus.
